title: Plate Armour +1

fields.Defence: AC 19, Heavy Armour proficiency, Disadvantage on Stealth checks. Superior Plate reduces Piercing damage by 1.
fields.Acquisition: Levelled magic armour traders for character levels 8–10. Also worn by Cashguard Captain Faril at the Counting House.
fields.Base value: 800 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
